page_header: Section A — Very Short Answer Question

steps.label: A pure line
steps.why: Breeding close relatives brings the same alleles together, so the herd becomes uniform.
steps.memory_tip: Inbreeding raises homozygosity and gives a pure line.
lines: helps to produce a pure line of animals.

steps.label: Selecting genes
steps.why: Because the herd becomes uniform, a breeder can see which animals carry the wanted genes and drop the rest.
steps.memory_tip: Keep the good genes, remove the bad ones.
steps.margin_note: The second advantage closes the answer.

lines.text: 2. It gathers superior genes and removes bad ones

insider_note: Two advantages are asked, so give exactly two and name homozygosity in the first.
